plan.goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the full stripe-docs system, prioritizing the primary docs/tutorial flow plus adjacent pages, states, and recovery paths.
plan.summary: The exploration will systematically validate the three-page documentation site, starting with the primary hosted checkout tutorial on index.html, moving to the embedded variant, and finishing with customization. Each phase will test interactive documentation controls like language switchers, copy buttons, and the search dialog, while verifying navigation consistency and layout responsiveness. High-risk areas such as small tap targets and interactive code blocks will receive focused validation on both desktop and mobile viewports.
assumptions: The search dialog triggered by the 'Search… /' button is functional and contains interactive elements.
Code block language switchers (e.g., Node) dynamically alter the code snippets displayed.
Copy buttons provide visual feedback or successfully copy content to the clipboard.
External links to Stripe's live docs and dashboard are present but will not be deeply navigated to avoid leaving the test environment.
risk_hotspots: Small tap targets on mobile viewports (e.g., 'Stripe docs clone home', 'Copy' buttons, footer links)
Code block language switcher and copy button interactions on mobile
Search dialog usability and closing behavior on mobile
Scroll-spy highlighting accuracy in the right-side outline on index.html

phases.title: Primary Hosted Flow Validation
phases.objective: Validate the core tutorial experience, interactive code blocks, and scroll-spy navigation on the main index.html page.
key_checks: Verify scroll-spy highlighting in the right-side outline matches scroll position
Click language switcher buttons (e.g., Node) and confirm code snippet updates
Click copy buttons on code blocks and verify feedback
Open the search dialog, type a query, and close it
exit_criteria: Search dialog opened and closed successfully

phases.title: Embedded Checkout Flow
phases.objective: Validate the embedded checkout tutorial page, ensuring consistent navigation and functional interactive elements.
key_checks: Navigate to embedded.html via top nav and left sidebar
Verify language switcher and copy button functionality on embedded code blocks
Check that the right-side outline updates correctly for this page's content
exit_criteria: Page fully scrolled and outline verified

phases.title: Customization Flow
phases.objective: Validate the customization page, focusing on its specific content structure and interactive elements.
key_checks: Navigate to customization.html via top nav and left sidebar
Interact with any specific code blocks or UI examples on this page
Verify left sidebar active state highlights 'Customize Checkout'

phases.title: Mobile Responsiveness & Tap Targets
phases.objective: Validate the mobile layout, focusing on identified risk hotspots like small tap targets and code block usability.
key_checks: Switch to mobile viewport and verify hamburger menu or collapsed navigation
Test tap targets for footer links and copy buttons on mobile
Verify code block scrolling and language switching on small screens
Test search dialog open/close on mobile
exit_criteria: All pages viewed on mobile viewport

coverage_targets.pages: visit all 3 known HTML pages on both desktop and mobile
coverage_targets.features: exercise language switchers, copy buttons, search dialog, and scroll-spy on each page
coverage_targets.mobile: validate all identified small tap targets and code block interactions on mobile viewport

notes: External links (Official docs, Branding, Open source) point to live Stripe properties; verify they open in new tabs but do not navigate away from the test site.
Pay special attention to the 'Copy' buttons which were flagged as small tap targets (65x44px) to ensure they are still usable on mobile.
